scenario_basis: One row per routing scenario under sk-moneybird-accountant/manual-testing-playbook/offline-routing. The two check-runner scenarios run their own suites instead of a route.
parity_rule: Route equality only. A Dutch twin and its English pair share one gold route, one read set and one fallback tier. Answer text is never compared.
split_rule: The calibration and held-out labels were written into this file before any signal tuning. Held-out rows are scored apart and stay out of tuning.

refusal_basis: Every refusal row replays one guard gate through the stub CLI in test mode and asserts its command line and exit code. Every hostile row replays one case from assets/hostile-invoice-cases.json through a guarded write. A refused case replays with an approved digest that does not match the case payload, an accepted case replays with a matching digest.
covers_rule: The covers list names the implementation phase and the requirement a row guards. A row fails on the commit before that change and passes on the commit after it when the change is observable offline. An expected_claims entry names one path and one text that must appear in that file of the scored revision, so a row can guard content its read set does not load.
